name: Mediterranean chickpea salad
summary: Chickpeas, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, red pepper, olives and feta in a lemon and oregano dressing, a crunchy lunch that keeps for days in the fridge.
about: This salad borrows from the eastern Mediterranean, where chickpeas, olives, tomato, cucumber and feta are everyday foods. The chickpeas soak up the lemon dressing instead of going soggy, so a bowl made on Sunday lasts for weekday lunchboxes.
steps: Shake the olive oil, lemon zest and juice, vinegar, oregano, garlic, salt and pepper together in a jar with a lid for 20 seconds, until the dressing looks cloudy and slightly thick.
Shake the rinsed chickpeas dry in a sieve so they take up more of the dressing. Tip them into a large bowl, pour over the dressing, stir and leave for 10 minutes while you chop the vegetables.
Add the cucumber, tomatoes, red pepper, red onion, olives and parsley and toss until everything is glossy with dressing. Taste and add a little more salt if it needs it.
Scatter the feta over the top and serve, or pack into lidded containers for the week; the flavour is even better on the second day.
prepNote: Keeps 4 days in a covered container in the fridge; scraping the seeds from the cucumber keeps it crisp.
